title: 第三章 你要娶谁？咋就变卦了！
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

方才还满面堆笑，盘算着跟沈时觐提和林柔婚期的林大国和陈琴，脸上的笑容瞬间褪去。

陈琴憋着一口怨气，眼睛瞟向沈时觐，嘴角用力往下扯。

“时觐，昨天你不是和柔柔相的亲吗？你也认下这门亲事的，这板上钉钉的事，你现在怎么能说变就变呢？”

“再说了，这事现在全村都传遍了，你突然改口要娶林栀，那柔柔的脸面往哪搁？你让她以后还咋在村里做人？”

林大国一屁股坐到炕上，脸上沉得能滴出水来。

昨晚他们两口子就怕这门亲事会有变故，特意在饭桌上灌了沈时觐好多杯酒，就想趁他迷糊的时候和柔柔把生米煮成熟饭，省得他日后反悔。

谁成想他们把他扶回屋里躺好，去叫柔柔的功夫，这小子竟然把屋里的门给反锁了，任凭他们怎么敲门也不开，这事才没成。

他用力拍了拍大腿，心想，早知道这样，昨晚说啥也得把锁给撬了。

他的目光落向沈时觐，眉毛拧成麻花，阴沉着脸。

“柔柔平时连刷锅洗碗的小活都舍不得干，就是怕把手弄糙了给你丢人，你现在临时变卦，不是把柔柔往绝路上逼吗？”

说着双手一摊：“就算你们沈家是高门大户，也不能这么欺负人吧。”

林柔咬着唇，眼睛定定地望着沈时觐，心里一万个不相信。

她可是读过书的文化人，那个林栀就是个大字不识一个的乡巴佬。

沈时觐怎么会放着她这个养尊宠优的娇小姐不要，偏偏看上这个在家里做惯苦力的死丫头。

更何况她皮肤白皙，模样长的好看，身材更是要哪有哪，再看那个死丫头又瘦又柴的，哪里比得过她？

沈时觐一定是眼瞎了，才会选那个死丫头。

对，一定是这样。

不然换做谁都会选她的。

话虽这么说，强烈的自尊心和巨大的失落感让她还是无法接受眼下这个事实。

她鼻尖一抽一抽的，啪嗒啪嗒的掉眼泪。

沉默良久，唇角牵强地露出一抹笑来：“时觐哥，你，你……为什么选栀栀不选我？”

她眼巴巴的盯着沈时觐，一副受伤的表情，试图让他心软。

不光是林柔想知道原因，林栀也很是不解。

昨晚沈时觐明确拒绝了她，怎么今天突然就想通了？

难道是……脑袋被驴给踢了？

想到这，她还十分认真的瞄了几眼沈时觐。

可他一切正常，看样子不像。

这事怪得很。

沈时觐唇角动了动。

这年头姑娘家的名节比啥都重要，虽说他不喜欢甚至厌恶气愤这个算计他的女人，可他也不会做出让别人戳她脊梁骨的事情来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Daguo and Chen Qin, who were still smiling just now and planning their wedding to Shen Shijinti and Lin Rou, suddenly lost their smiles.

Chen Qin held back a breath of resentment, glanced at Shen Shijin, and pulled down the corners of his mouth.

"Shi Jin, didn't you have a kiss with Rourou yesterday? You also accepted this marriage. This is a sure thing, how can you change it now?"

"Besides, this matter has been spread throughout the village now. You suddenly changed your mind and wanted to marry Lin Zhi. Where will you put Rourou's face? How will she behave in the village in the future?"

Lin Daguo sat down on the kang, his face so heavy that water dripped from his face.

Last night, the couple was afraid that something would happen to their marriage, so they deliberately poured Shen Shijin many glasses of wine at the dinner table, hoping to cook the raw rice with Rourou while he was confused, so as to prevent him from regretting it in the future.

Who would have thought that when they helped him back into the house to lie down, and went to call Rourou, the boy actually locked the door of the house, and refused to open it no matter how hard they knocked, so it didn't happen.

He patted his thigh hard and thought, if he had known this, he would have had to pick the lock last night.

His eyes fell on Shen Shijin, his eyebrows were twisted into knots, and his face was gloomy.

"Rourou is usually reluctant to even do the small chores of washing pots and dishes, just for fear of getting her hands rough and embarrassing you. Now that you have changed your mind at the last minute, aren't you pushing Rourou into a dead end?"

He spread his hands and said, "Even if your Shen family is a wealthy family, you can't bully others like this."

Lin Rou bit her lip and stared at Shen Shijin with unwavering disbelief.

She was a well-educated and educated person, while Lin Zhi was just a country bumpkin who couldn't read a word.

How could Shen Shijin let go of a pampered and pampered young lady like her, but instead set his sights on this dead girl who was used to doing hard work at home.

What's more, she has fair skin, good looks, and an incredible figure. And look at that damn girl who is so skinny and mean, how can she compare to her?

Shen Shijin must be blind to choose that dead girl.

Yes, that must be the case.

Otherwise, anyone would choose her.

Having said that, her strong self-esteem and huge sense of loss prevented her from accepting the current fact.

The tip of her nose twitched and she shed tears.

After a long silence, a forced smile appeared on the corner of his lips: "Brother Shi Jin, you, you... why did you choose Zhizhi instead of me?"

She stared at Shen Shijin with a hurt expression, trying to make him soften.

Not only Lin Rou wanted to know the reason, but Lin Zhi was also puzzled.

Shen Shijin clearly rejected her last night, why did he suddenly figure it out today?

Could it be that... his head was kicked by a donkey?

Thinking of this, she took a few serious glances at Shen Shijin.

But everything is normal with him, it doesn't look like it.

This is very strange.

The corners of Shen Shijin's lips moved.

These days, the reputation of a girl's family is more important than anything else. Although he doesn't like or even hates and is angry with this woman who plotted against him, he will not do anything to let others poke her spine.
